top_signals.title: Indian Stocks Beat Asian Peers by Most In Over a Year on AI Rout
top_signals.summary: Indian equities outpaced Asian peers on Thursday, as an unwinding of the artificial intelligence trade spurred a rotation toward markets that had largely missed the surge.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
